_comment: Gain-vs-primary-position scan (see tools/gain_scan.py). Lean config: single-electron Townsend gain only. ion drift OFF (gain is independent of it and it is the dominant cost); amplifier OFF and conductive readout (gain is independent of both); short time window (gain ignores it). energy_keV=0.026 -> nPrimary=1, so avalanche_size is the single-electron gain directly. The 'gas' block is byte-identical to default_tgc.json so the committed .gas table is reused (no Magboltz regeneration). The driver overrides source_distances_mm per process via --distance; the x grid below is the transverse scan across one central wire cell (wires at (i-4.5)*0.18 cm -> central wire at +0.09 cm).
